images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity desktop customer support admin screen, landscape 16:10, flat front-on screenshot, no device frame
Primary request: Chinese Nexion admin customer support upgrade. Keep navigation: narrow left rail, top breadcrumb "客服中心 / 会话", tabs "工作台 / 工单 / 会话 / 知识库 / 服务规则". Four columns including rail: 52px rail, 290px inbox, 640px chat, 340px customer profile. Professional dense usable operating software, generous spacing, crisp Chinese labels.
Style: existing obsidian near-black surfaces #0A0A0A #121214 #17171B, neutral subtle borders, white headings muted grey secondary text, sky blue support accent #38BDF8; lime #9EDC1D primary action. Flat surfaces, no nested cards. 14px body. Rounded pill buttons. Tiny real-looking portrait avatars for customer and advisor.
Top thin strip "设计示例 · 不连接服务". Inbox title "我的会话", search, filters "全部 24 / 未读 6 / 进行中 / 已结束 / 归档"; "主动联系" and "圈选群发" buttons. Customer rows show name, customer code, last message, unread count, current advisor, pagination.
Chat title "林先生  客户 B002 · 等级 2", "当前顾问 Mia", "在线状态未知"; toolbar "历史 / 转工单 / 结束服务 / 归档". Left customer dark charcoal bubbles and avatar; right advisor sky blue bubbles and avatar with dark text. A reply says "设备信息已收到，我会继续核对。" Caption "已发送 · 未读", not fake online signals. SKU message card "Uvel Box S1" with "查看商品" CTA and neutral thumbnail; previous customer asks "我的设备在哪里查看？". Small explicit pending reply indicator. Composer toolbar "图片 / 回复模板 / 顾问话术 / 商品", textarea, intent segmented "普通联系 / 联系维护", lime "发送预览" action; note "维护发送后等待新的有效账户活动".
Profile right scrollable with four collapsible sections. Header "客户资料" and "打开 360". Identity name/code/id, masked phone, region, registration, last login; separate "上次有效活动 未知". Badges "账户活跃未知 / 正常维护", current advisor. Finance per currency "累计充值 1,280 USDT / 累计提现本金 320 USDT", refund separately; CNY "0 CNY"; risk "未知 · 数据待核对", device "2 台 · 在网 1". Notes tags and tickets links visible. Maintenance fields last execution,next due,success cycles separate. Remaining data continues by visible scrollbar rather than deleted.
Constraints: all data are design examples. Preserve strict current advisor-only private communication. No advisor switching, no KYC, no temporary handoff, no deceptive success. Do not show internal enums. Make an implementable beautiful screenshot, consistent enough for HTML recreation.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: landscape high fidelity Chinese customer support admin multi-step flow design board, three equal desktop panels laid left to right, 2400x1200 intent.
Primary request: "圈选群发" flow for current advisor Mia's own clients, each person receives independent private 1v1 messages. Match Nexion obsidian surfaces #0A0A0A #121214 #17171B neutral borders, sky #38BDF8, lime #9EDC1D primary pill buttons, clear white Chinese type, no shadows or nested card maze.
Board heading "设计示例 · 本人客户群发". Panel 1 heading "1 圈选客户", row "当前顾问 Mia · 仅本人客户"; search, account status select, maintenance status select, currency select, date range native fields; small "更多筛选" for level/tags/recharge/withdrawal. Table checkboxes with name/code/account state/maintenance and selected count. Three checked eligible rows "林先生 B002 活跃 正常维护", "王女士 A389 未知 正常维护", "陈先生 C721 沉睡 正常维护"; fourth disabled "张女士 B556 活跃 不再维护" with text "排除主动联系". Footer "已选 3 位 · 名单已固定" and "下一步".
Panel 2 heading "2 内容与确认". Pills "普通联系" and selected "联系维护". textarea "最近的设备使用还顺利吗？如有需要，可以在这里留言。"; toolbar "图片 / 模板 / 商品". Recipient list exactly three selected codes, excluded row separately. Note "每客消息成功保存才记一次维护执行；账户后续有效活动才计成功。不会自动清除待回复。"; preview advisor avatar message sky bubble; buttons "返回修改" and lime "确认预览".
Panel 3 heading "3 逐客结果". Summary "成功 1 / 失败 1 / 跳过 1". Table "B002 发送成功 已保存，未读", "A389 读取原结果中 暂不重复发送", "C721 已跳过 归属已变更". Row error detail uses Chinese. "取消待发送" button, "查询原结果" and "仅重试失败项". Note "已成功项不重复；已发消息不能撤回整批。普通联系不计维护。". Small explanatory field "维护执行 1 · 维护成功 0".
Constraints: all data labelled design examples. Strict current advisor identity, no role dropdown giving permissions, exclude stopped customers from both contact intents. Preserve drafts when returning/cancelling; show partial failures and uncertain outcome distinctly; no API implementation jargon on screen. Beautiful deployable-looking admin interaction storyboard, enough space for all labels.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity Chinese Nexion admin settings and advisor avatar design, wide landscape two-page board
Primary request: TWO equal panels on an obsidian dark admin surface #0A0A0A #121214 #17171B, subtle neutral borders, white type muted grey helper text, sky #38BDF8 secondary, lime #9EDC1D main pill buttons. Header "设计示例 · 分配策略与顾问头像". Preserve minimal toolbar navigation no redesign.
Left panel title "无顾问客户分配". Single radio group "自动随机分配" selected / "主管分配" unselected, exactly one shared mode. Readable note "有效邀请继承优先；仅处理真正未绑定客户。已绑定顾问离线或停用不重分配。" Impact preview "仅影响保存后新进入客户 · 历史池不自动处理"; textarea "修改理由", buttons "取消" and "预览修改". Under a divider section "历史池 · 单独批量随机分配"; search with cause filter, two eligible selected rows "B008 自然注册 无顾问", "B011 继承超限 无顾问", third disabled "B012 关系待核对". Candidate summary "合格顾问 3 · 在线状态不影响候选". Footer "已选 2 位 · 预览实际名单". Small confirm area shows "新继承起点：各客户本人 0 层；已有下级不改变", required reason, unchecked checkbox "已核对名单与影响". Secondary status callout "自动新记录无候选：待重试，可查询任务；历史池不自动追加。". No hidden toggles per reason.
Right panel title "创建 / 编辑顾问". A1 account form name Mia, role selector "顾问 / 客服", status selector "启用", create/edit tabs. Large round female portrait with label "原头像"; next circle "替换预览" showing a different portrait. File picker "选择头像" and remove preview button, upload state "上传失败 · 原头像继续使用", button "重试上传". helper "已有无头像账号显示姓名占位；客户头像只读". Form below nickname and "对客坐席" status, note "超管可修改；历史消息作者身份不变". Footer "取消" and lime "预览保存". Optional create toggle field showing new avatar optional policy pending, do NOT declare mandatory.
Constraints: genuine design examples, not real administration. No production parameter defaults, no KYC. Mode save and historical batch are separate confirmations. Show permission denial as "仅超管可修改头像/策略". Preserve error draft. Do not add internal enums or API fields to visible labels. Beautiful dense practical desktop UI that can be directly recreated in HTML.
